correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and endpoints checked: k any even >=4; B=2^(nu_2(k)+2)<=2^k; finite n>=1, t in [0,B]; odd power subgroup 1+B Z_2 is surjective by 2-adic unit decomposition; disjoint classes 1..t and all-even branch yield A(n)=t2^(n-m)+A(n-k); the exact periodic formula follows by cancellation. Pointwise stripping is valid because any <B representation of a multiple of B has only even bases; Haar layers are disjoint and sum geometrically. Separate exhaustive modular bitset checks: 1056 cases; 390 exact comparisons to published k4 formula. No experiment is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: For the natural finite modular Waring counting problem, this is a complete all-even-exponent classification of each t-summand image, including an exact k-periodic error term and a closed Haar distribution of all minimal lengths. It unifies known k=4 special counts and differentiates k=4 (no final atom) from every even k>=6 (positive final atom). Such complete local frequencies complement, rather than merely restate, known maxima; they can serve as exact local obstructions and quantitative inputs for modular additive problems.
